purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a House Valence Three-Seal Accession at First Registry Enclave.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the accession chamber, ordinary clerk and host-service work, the double pledge, public sealing, worker surety, and state-gated succession outcomes.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the chamber establishing view, routine seal check, each preparation focus, routine fold, the double-pledge reveal, discovery response, public accession session, and each ending family. The missing star and the four-washer surety bond receive close visual emphasis because they turn continuity and redress into visible objects.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt stands alone for a general image model, names camera and room geometry, describes fictional tools and bodies visibly, and includes only characters or groups present in the frame. Continuity notes remain review constraints and are excluded from assembled prompts.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: bleak illustrated science-fiction procedural noir, black-glass architecture and pale metal, restrained ivory amber and deep blue palette, precise ink linework with painterly shadow, tactile documents and machinery, readable silhouettes, humane workplace details, cinematic interactive-fiction frame, abstract interface glyphs and non-readable document marks.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every render prompt from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups declared visible in that scene, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Exclude off-frame refs and visual_continuity_notes. Use the camera-specific scene-set blockout as visual input for final multi-angle replay rendering.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one accession chamber from several angles and makes doors, seal lamps, record custody, gallery sightlines, and clinic access consequential. The textual scene_set is sufficient for concept planning and spatial review, but not a substitute for a plan view or 3D blockout.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, build a camera-specific blockout of First Registry accession chamber from the fixed zones, routes, occluders, staging slots, and state anchors defined below.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view from the southern public doorway into a long rectangular corporate accession chamber. A low black-glass dais stands against the north wall beneath three large seal lamps colored white, blue, and amber. The west wall contains a dark archive vault door, a narrow clerk station, and a waist-high split-custody drawer. The east wall contains a formal finance desk and stacked metal escrow drawers. Client benches run along the south half. In the northeast corner, a transparent service-clinic wall reveals a faceted black-glass polyhedral machine mind suspended in an articulated pale-metal maintenance cradle, projecting tiny Earth constellations onto the glass. Pale floors, black reflective panels, controlled museum lighting, and visible security seams make the room elegant and coercive.

visible_characters.default_stance: suspended in the clinic cradle, projecting a steady constellation map

visual_continuity_notes: Coordinate frame faces north from the public entrance: Register vault and clerk station west, Covenant desk and escrow drawers east, dais north, client benches south, service clinic northeast.
The auction gallery lies beyond the east wall and is heard or glimpsed through its doorway; it is not part of the chamber floor.
Six Windows is a faceted synthetic host in a maintenance cradle, not a humanoid robot, coffin, cage, or biological brain display.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters visible in a scene.

characters.tavi_rook: Tavi Rook: baseline human junior provenance clerk, late twenties to thirties, warm brown skin, close-cropped black curls, attentive dark eyes, pale gray fitted clerk coat with black cuffs, narrow copper custody key looped at the left wrist, ink-marked fingertips, practical dark boots, compact careful posture that becomes very still under pressure.
characters.ivo_marn: Ivo Marn: baseline human host fitter, late forties to sixties, broad sturdy build, shaved head, lined face, cobalt service coveralls with pale insulated seams, compact tool harness, heat-resistant gloves often tucked at the belt, slightly stooped work posture and economical movements.
characters.ena_coil: Master Registrar Ena Coil: baseline human, late middle age, deep brown skin, silver braids pinned high, long black formal coat with narrow ivory register tabs, split-key pendant at the throat, straight-backed restrained posture, hands visible and still near sealed records.
characters.pell_orra: Covenant Steward Pell Orra: baseline human, forties, lean build, light olive skin, slick dark hair, plum-black finance coat with amber lining, small metal escrow-key rings on two fingers, immaculate cuffs, controlled posture oriented toward slates and accounts.
characters.lucerne_valence: Lucerne Valence: baseline human House Voice claimant, apparent thirties, tall and androgynous, pale skin, long straight black hair tied low, lacquer-white formal coat with a black-glass throat clasp and narrow silver lineage embroidery, empty hands, calm proprietary posture that never needs to hurry visibly.
characters.six_windows: Six Windows: nonhumanoid registered Eidolon host, a torso-sized faceted polyhedron of smoky black glass and pale metal suspended in an articulated six-armed service cradle; thin blue-gold light points project an Earth constellation map onto nearby glass; a strictly geometric body whose visual expression is limited to projected light and cradle motion; voice emerges as low resonant chimes.

groups.anchor_clients: Two Valence anchor-client witnesses: baseline humans in severe charcoal formal coats seated apart on the south client benches, each holding a closed thin allocation slate; composed faces, expensive understated clothing, posture changing through closed screens, withheld signatures, and quiet departure rather than raised voices.
